title: Least privilege in practice: federation, SSO and the escalation path nobody revoked

videos.script: Least privilege is easy to agree with. This lesson is about measuring it in an account that already exists. {{gap}} Every identity has two lists. What it is allowed to do, and what it actually does. The first one only grows. {{grow}} Nobody files a ticket to remove a permission that causes no error. Then the story. dani was a contractor, and she left in March. {{dani}} Her user stayed. So did her access key. So did a small policy that let her attach policies to users. {{policy}} You will switch moto's checking on, and watch that key attach the administrator policy to itself. {{escalate}} The request succeeds, and it prints nothing. That silence is the finding. {{find}} Then you look for paths like it, with the records AWS keeps and a short script. {{close}} And you close it in the right order. The key first, then the policies, then the user. Each step proved by asking again. {{end}}
